newsitem.title: USA: US adj retail sales up 0.3 pct in July--Redbook.
newsitem.headline: US adj retail sales up 0.3 pct in July--Redbook.

text.p: U.S. seasonally adjusted retail sales rose 0.3 percent in July versus June, according to the Lynch, Jones & Ryan Inc Redbook Retail Sales Index.

The index rose 8.5 percent compared with the same month a year ago, the report said. Adjusted retail sales jumped 9.2 percent in the week ended August 2, compared with the same week a year ago, it said.
Redbook Research Managing Director Jay Meltzer told Reuters Financial Television that July was the first month this year retailers exceeded their plans.
"Overall it was an excellent month," Meltzer said.
Clearance programs helped retailers pave the way for back-to-school merchandise, he said.
"They had planned these promotions, and they didn't think the traffic would be as good as it turned out," Meltzer added.
